reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

# infer segments by diagonal sum u from 7 positions (manually recognized), with d-range from each connected run of same u in demo2
# list each input marked positions and get runs by row-contiguous along u
pts=[tuple(map(int,p)) for p in np.argwhere(A==7)]
from collections import defaultdict
byu=defaultdict(list)
for r,c in pts: byu[r+c].append((r,c,c-r))
segments=[]
for u,vs in byu.items():
    ds=[x[2] for x in vs]
    segments.append((u,min(ds),max(ds)))
print(segments)
pred=np.zeros_like(A,dtype=bool)
for r in range(16):
 for c in range(16):
  if A[r,c]==7: continue
  d0=c-r; u0=r+c
  active=[u for u,lo,hi in segments if lo<=d0<=hi]
  if len(active)>=2 and min(active)<u0<max(active): pred[r,c]=True
print('prediction count',pred.sum(),'actual',np.sum(B==2),'diff',np.sum(pred!=(B==2)))
if np.sum(pred!=(B==2)):
 print('false+',np.argwhere(pred&(B!=2)).tolist())
 print('false-',np.argwhere((B==2)&~pred).tolist())
